hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Sucker rod string
function: The string of steel (or fiberglass) rods, 25 or 30 ft long, coupled from the polished rod down to the pump plunger, carrying the pump load through the tubing.

tabs.overview: Rods from 5/8 to 1-1/4 in. in a tapered string, heavier at the top where the load is highest; rod guides where the tubing curves; a sinker bar above the pump to keep the string in tension on the downstroke.
tabs.engineering: Taper design per API 11B; stretch and load from the pump depth, fluid, and stroke.
tabs.safety: Rod parts drop the bridle load; fished with the rig.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
tabs.failure_modes: Fatigue parts at couplings, wear against the tubing in the curve, corrosion pitting.
